mechanism: NSAIDs may reduce the efficacy of vedolizumab by inhibiting prostaglandin-mediated immune responses and increasing GI ulceration risk in immunosuppressed patients; vedolizumab increases infection risk which compounds NSAID-related GI toxicity.
action: Use lowest effective NSAID dose for shortest duration; monitor closely for GI symptoms and consider gastroprotection; alternative analgesics (acetaminophen, topical NSAIDs) preferred when possible.
